description: Task 2C matrix row 6 — RAG's deployment is being rolled back from N to N-1 (expected_image_digest targets the ROLLBACK image, mirroring how Task 2B's compatible-rollback fixture judges 'whichever image this release action targets' rather than hardcoding latest), but the rollback target's own accepted set does not include the LIVE Billing hash (N) still in production.
